AC amendment (gap G5): Simplify the redundant awk wrapper. Replace:
`grep -c 'DEPRECATED' plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md | awk '{ if ($1 < 1) exit 1 }'`
with:
`grep -q 'DEPRECATED.*stateless reconciler.*4047-3cb1-6cb4-46a1' plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md`
grep -q already exits 0 on match, 1 on no-match. The awk layer adds no signal.
